Whereof ri{{ls}}e their holy daies and Cōmemorations.}}∷ {{ls}}hal be reported for a memorie of her. {{verse|chapter=26|verse=14}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Mr. 14, 10. Lu. 22, 3.''}}* Then went one of the Tvvelue, vvhich vvas called Iudas I{{ls}}carioth, to the cheefe Prie{{ls}}tes, {{verse|chapter=26|verse=15}}† and {{ls}}aid to them, What vvil you giue me, and I vvil deliuer him vnto you? But they appointed vnto him thirtie peeces of {{ls}}iluer. {{verse|chapter=26|verse=16}}† And from thenceforth he {{ls}}ought opportunitie to betray him.

{{verse|chapter=26|verse=17}}† {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text={{sc|Mavndy}} thur{{ls}}day.}}And {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Mr. 14, 12. Lu. 22, 7.''}}* the fir{{ls}}t day of the Azymes the Di{{ls}}ciples came to {{sc|Iesvs}}, {{ls}}aying, Where vvilt thou that vve prepare for thee to eate the Pa{{ls}}che? {{verse|chapter=26|verse=18}}† But {{sc|Iesvs}} {{ls}}aid, Goe ye into the citie to a certaine man: and {{ls}}ay to him, The Mai{{ls}}ter {{ls}}aith, My time is at hand, vvith thee do I make the Pa{{ls}}che vvith my Di{{ls}}ciples. {{verse|chapter=26|verse=19}}† And the Di{{ls}}ciples did as {{sc|Iesvs}} appointed them, and they prepared the Pa{{ls}}che. {{verse|chapter=26|verse=20}}† But vvhen it vvas euen, he {{ls}}ate downe vvith his {{sup|‖}} tvvelue Di{{ls}}ciples. {{verse|chapter=26|verse=21}}† And vvhile they vvere eating, he {{ls}}aid: Amen I {{ls}}ay to you, that one of you {{ls}}hal betray me. {{verse|chapter=26|verse=22}}† And they being very {{ls}}ad, began euery one to {{ls}}ay, Is it I Lord? {{verse|chapter=26|verse=23}}† But he an{{ls}}vvering {{ls}}aid, {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''P{{ls}}. 40, 10.''}}* He that dippeth his hand vvith me in the di{{ls}}h, he {{ls}}hal betray me. {{verse|chapter=26|verse=24}}† The Sonne of man in deede goeth as it is vvritten of him: but vvo be to that man, by vvhom the Sonne of man {{ls}}hal be betrayed. It vvere good for him, if that man had not been borne. {{verse|chapter=26|verse=25}}† And Iudas that betrayed him, an{{ls}}vvering {{ls}}aid, Is it I Rabbi? He {{ls}}aith to him, Thou ha{{ls}}t {{ls}}aid.

{{verse|chapter=26|verse=26}}† And {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''1. Cor. 11, 24.''}}* vvhiles they vvere at {{ls}}upper, {{sc|Iesvs}} {{sup|‖}} tooke bread, and {{sup|‖}} ble{{ls}}sed, and brake: and he gaue to his Di{{ls}}ciples, and {{ls}}aid, Take ye, and eate: {{sup|‖}} {{sc|This is {{sup|‖}} my body}}. {{verse|chapter=26|verse=27}}† And taking the chalice, {{sup|‖}} he gaue thankes: and gaue to them, {{ls}}aying: Drinke {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ See the margent note ''Mar. 14, 23.''}}∷ ye al of this. {{verse|chapter=26|verse=28}}† For {{sc|this is {{sup|‖}} my blovd of}}<noinclude>{{rh||K ij|{{sc|the}}}}</noinclude>
